connector.name: Pi-hole MCP Server by hexamatic
connector.registryDescription: Manage Pi-hole v6: DNS blocking, domains, clients, query analysis, DHCP, and multi-instance sync.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image pihole-mcp:0.8.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hexamatic account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PIHOLE_URL
env.description: Base URL of your Pi-hole web interface. For multiple Pi-holes use PIHOLE_1_URL, PIHOLE_2_URL, ... instead.

env.name: PIHOLE_PASSWORD
env.description: Pi-hole admin password, or an application password (recommended — bypasses TOTP 2FA)

env.name: TZ
env.description: IANA timezone for rendered timestamps, e.g. Australia/Adelaide. Defaults to UTC in the container.

env.name: PIHOLE_TLS_SKIP_VERIFY
env.description: Set to true only for a Pi-hole serving a self-signed HTTPS certificate. A trusted certificate is the better fix.

env.name: PIHOLE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT
env.description: HTTP request timeout as a Go duration, e.g. 30s or 1m

env.name: PIHOLE_MAX_RETRIES
env.description: Retries after a transient Pi-hole API failure; 0 disables retrying

env.name: PIHOLE_RETRY_MAX_DELAY
env.description: Upper bound on a single exponential-backoff wait, as a Go duration
